quarterly_data.quarter: Alpha and Omega Semiconductor press release: Alpha and Omega Semiconductor's New MOS E2 600V Super (09-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: AOS released its new alphaMOS E2 600V Super Junction MOSFET platform with two top-side-cooled parts, AOGT037V60DE2 (600 V, 37 mOhm) and AOGT060V60DE2 (600 V, 60 mOhm), in its GTPAK package, targeting servers, workstations, telecom rectifiers, solar inverters, motor drives and industrial power systems (AC/DC power supplies, DC/DC converters, DC/AC solar inverters; boost PFC, totem-pole PFC, LLC, PSFB and cyclo-converter topologies). The company cites body-diode ruggedness of di/dt = 1500 A/us, UIS avalanche capability and short-circuit withstand time. Both parts are 'now available in production quantities with a lead time of 16 weeks', at unit prices of $6.00 and $3.00 respectively in 1,000-piece quantities.
quarterly_data.figure: AOGT037V60DE2 600 V / 37 mOhm, AOGT060V60DE2 600 V / 60 mOhm; di/dt 1500 A/us; production quantities, 16-week lead time; $6.00 and $3.00 per unit at 1,000 pieces
